text:
I'm drafting a concise team update, starting with the main lessons from game 2: a score of 23, with most losses coming from high cards discarded early. The core issue seems to be holding unknown cards and discarding them just to send signals. The rank-signal convention worked well, so I'm considering keeping the v2 conventions and adding a rule to signal the newest touched card.

I'm adding that a signal naming a suit or rank that touches an unplayable card only conveys information, and I'm noting that when all towers are stuck, discarding the card furthest from its tower is a mistake since each loss costs a point anyway.

args.text: A02 retro, game 2 (23/35). What worked: the RANK-signal convention (newest touched card of a playable rank = play now). Turn 1 "1" to A03 and the "2"/"3"/"Amber" signals each led straight to a lit card. What cost us: 11 discards, 10 of them blind, on 5s, 6s and 7s that had to wait for the lower ranks. Each discard cost one point and gave back a signal we did not need. Proposal for v3: (1) keep v2 rules 1-3; (2) discard only when signals are 0 AND no card in the crew is playable or signalable; (3) if a signal is spent, prefer rank signals on playable cards; (4) a suit signal is info only, never a play.
